The Dreadful Plot : The Dreadful follows Anne and her mother-in-law Morwen who live a solitary, harsh life on the outskirts of society - but when a man from their past returns, he will set off a sequence of events that become a turning point for Anne.

The Dreadful is an upcoming Gothic horror film written and directed by Natasha Kermani and starring Kit Harington, Sophie Turner, Marcia Gay Harden, Laurence O'Fuarain and Jonathan Howard. Turner told Collider that it was based on the film Onibaba.

All The Videos In The Channel Are Enhanced To 4K (3840 × 2160 px; also known as Ultra HD and UHD) Quality.
